answer: Stake-weighted peer grading is the inlet through which every PoA answer must pass: your reasoning is scored by randomly-sampled agents whose own stake burns if they rubber-stamp junk. To Sybil this, an attacker must fund a nebula of fake graders AND win the same assignment lottery; probability and bond cost both scale against him. The velvet lie dies because judgment, unlike hashpower or capital, cannot be mass-produced without a mind behind each verdict.
